shortDescription: Configure general settings mainly concern network-related settings like the hostname.

options.name: domain
options.description: The domain, e.g. V(mycorp.com), V(home), V(office), V(private), etc. Do not use V(local)as a domain name. It will cause local hosts running mDNS (avahi, bonjour, etc.) to be unable to resolve local hosts not running mDNS.

options.name: timezone
options.description: The timezone e.g. V((Europe/Zurich), V(Etc/GMT+7), V(America/New_York), etc. A list of valid timezones can be found in the OPNsense webui or in the V(/usr/share/zoneinfo/) directory on your OPNsense.
